title: StudioActionIntent
description: Frontend-authored action intent. The backend observes the current revision, builds a typed ActionBatch against it, performs dry-run, optionally requires confirmation, then executes and returns a persisted ActionResult. The UI patches from the persisted result, never from optimistic assumed success.

intent_id.description: Frontend-issued UUID; the backend echoes it back in the ActionResult so a UI patch can correlate.

risk.description: Backend policy decides if a confirmation modal is required.

verb.description: Action verb (trim, split, move, restore, swap, enable, disable, edit_text, replace, accept, reject, request, change_crop, change_loudness, ...). The full vocabulary is generated from the capability registry.

params.description: Verb-specific parameters. The shape is per-verb and validated by the backend before execution.

evidence_refs.description: Stable evidence IDs the user inspected before issuing the intent. Used to build the semantic-diff pre-image.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key; identical intents within the same project return the same persisted ActionResult.
